title: NOG Announces Proposed $500 Million Private Offering of Senior Notes
summary: Northern Oil and Gas, Inc. (NYSE: NOG) (the “Company” or “NOG”) today announced that it intends to offer, subject to market and other conditions, $500 million in aggregate principal amount of senior notes due 2034 (the “Notes”) in a private offering to eligible purchasers under Rule 144A and Regulation S of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”). The Company intends to use the net proceeds from the offering to repay a portion of the outstanding borrowings under its revolving credit facility and the remainder, if any, for general corporate purposes. The Notes will not be registered under the Securities Act or under any state or other securities laws and may not be offered or sold within the United States, or to or for the account or benefit of any U.S. person, absent registration or an applicable exemption from registration requirements.
